t: r/Banksy on Reddit: Anyone have any tips on purchasing orginal banksy prints on eBay?
s: July 23, 2023 - Guy Hepner Gallery in New York sells legit Banksy’s. I wouldn’t go off EBay. ... Just to add, there are plenty of rather dodgy galleries, so don’t trust them all. There are some very good non bricks and mortar galleries (also unscrupulous) ones. If you let the community know where you live, i’m sure we can help point you in the correct direction. Provenance is really good to know (the history, where is was bought, by who, any receipts, what tube did it come in). However, buying a Banksy print without COA is not advised at all unless you really know what you’re doing.
